result_text:
The region overview now lists open support tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. That is the same order as the sales rep list.

I changed the `ORDER BY` in `DataStore.listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` (`DataStore.java`, around line 10023) to sort by priority before `opened_date` and `id`. Closed tickets and tickets of other regions are filtered out as before. `RegionManagerService.overviewFor` is the only caller, so the overview picks this up without further changes.

I ran the ticket and region test classes with `mvn -o` and they passed. I didn't add a test for the new order, so your T-1 to T-5 example isn't covered by a test.
